slides.title: Bioinformatics for drug discovery
bullets: Turns large biological datasets into decisions at each stage of a programme

bullets.text: Target identification: rank disease-linked genes from transcriptomics, genetics and literature-curated pathways
Target validation support: check expression in the relevant tissues, cell types and patient subgroups to guide functional testing
Mechanism of action: read out pathway responses to compound treatment from RNA-seq and proteomics
Biomarker candidates: propose response signatures and monitoring markers for independent validation
Safety signals: flag off-target and tissue-expression liabilities before chemistry is committed

bullets: Every analysis is reproducible: data provenance, versioned pipelines and an acceptance check before results are released
Outcome: fewer, better-evidenced targets and earlier no-go decisions, so lab budget goes on the compounds that matter
slides.notes: This is the slide people ask for. Walk left to right along a programme: which target, does it matter in patients, what does the compound do, who will respond. Stress that we hand over decisions, not data dumps, and that the group's labs (Brindlewythe, Merrivoss) can test the hypotheses quickly.
slides.footer: Quenverell Computational Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Edinburgh | Confidential

slides.title: Virtual library triage
bullets: Virtual screening of client and commercial-scale libraries
Physicochemical and ADMET property models to filter candidate sets
Prioritise what gets made and tested; retain library provenance and selection rules
bullets_right: Agreed target question and library identity
slides.notes: Retain the distinction between ranking and activity confirmation. A target campaign requires data acceptance and scientific scoping before analysis.

slides.title: Docking and hit clustering
bullets: Docking and pose review for hit triage
Cluster candidates to expose chemical redundancy and preserve interpretable diversity
Review poses alongside chemical plausibility and the target question
Analogue prioritisation fed straight to Vellacombe chemists for synthesis
Predictions guide experiments; scores do not establish measured binding potency
slides.notes: Ask which structures and target information are available and what purchase or synthesis decision is needed. Docking scope is agreed locally; no separate list price is stated here.
slides.footer: Quenverell Computational Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Edinburgh | Confidential

slides.title: RNA-seq differential expression
bullets: Bulk and single-cell RNA-seq differential expression
Pathway and network enrichment against curated knowledge bases
Compound-treated RNA-seq to read out pathway responses
Metadata and biological contrasts agreed before analysis
bullets_right: Analysis notebook and data acceptance record
slides.notes: Every engagement starts from the biological question and ends with a decision the project team can act on. Batch effects and confounded contrasts can limit the answer even if processing completes.
slides.footer: Quenverell Computational Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Edinburgh | Confidential

slides.title: Data acceptance and reproducibility
bullets: Metadata reconciled against sample manifests before any analysis
Batch-effect review and documented exclusions
Pipelines under version control; every figure traceable to code and input
Independent review before release; deviations recorded in the analysis notebook
slides.notes: Clients in regulated settings care about this slide more than the science.
